semantics: The 48 source OL records are collapsed to 47 project works before pair mass is summed.
If multiple source OL records under one project work receive different LLM entity statuses, the project-level status is MULTI_RECORD_CONFLICT rather than choosing one source-record judgment.
Maria Edgeworth therefore contributes 1,885 pairs once, not twice.
Exact candidate-set duplication among different project works, including the Charles Lamb group, does not collapse those project works into one conceptual work.
Human judgments are retained only as a review overlay. They do not partially replace the 48-record frozen LLM classification.
No status category in this artifact is itself an OpenAlex retrieval-validity label.
